未来节点按区间起点标记：2025点代表2025—2030的区间末值。: Future points are labelled by interval start: the 2025 point shows the value at the end of 2025–2030.
收获面积按每次收获累计，含复种，不是实际占地面积；单产按收获面积计算。作物总产量: Harvested area counts each harvest, including multiple cropping; it is not physical land area. Yield uses harvested area. Crop totals include feed and non-food crops.
1970—2010年投资占比使用同价历史锚点，2015—2020年按PWT 11: Investment shares use historical constant-price anchors for 1970–2010 and PWT 11.0 trend estimates for 2015–2020. Investment and consumption use 2005 PPP prices; forecasts start in 2025.
历史温升采用HadCRUT5，CO₂采用NOAA冒纳罗亚年均值。海平面1970—: Historical warming uses HadCRUT5; CO₂ uses NOAA annual Mauna Loa observations. Sea level uses PSMSL reconstructions for 1970–1990 and University of Colorado satellite observations for 1995–2020, referenced to 1850. Scenarios from 2025 are editable. CO₂-equivalent covers the warming effect of long-lived greenhouse gases: 1970 and 1975 are historical estimates converted from IPCC data; 1980–2020 uses NOAA published values.
各地区1970—2020年历史已按NFBA 2026版更新，补齐2015、202: Regional history for 1970–2020 uses NFBA 2026, including 2015 and 2020. Missing consumption components, early country splits and small-region gaps are labelled as historical estimates. Rest of the world is the global total minus the other four regions. Forecasts start in 2025.
海平面与图10统一显示较1850年的上升量，两图共用同一预测。: Sea level uses the same forecast and 1850 reference as Graph 10.
计算方法：劳动生产率 = GDP ÷ 15—64岁人口 × 1000000（万亿: Calculation: labour productivity = GDP ÷ population aged 15–64 × 1,000,000 (trillion 2005 PPP USD / million people converted to 2005 PPP USD/person)
计算方法：2030人口 = 2025人口 × [1 + (出生率 − 死亡率): Calculation: population in 2030 = population in 2025 × [1 + (birth rate − death rate) ÷ 100 × 5]
计算方法：人口负担 = 总人口 ÷ 15—64岁人口: Calculation: support burden = total population ÷ population aged 15–64
